schema.description: Phone with an explicit country code: "+<country code> <number>" or "(<country code>)<number>", e.g. "+60 123456789". A space or hyphen may separate a plus-prefixed country code from the number. The number accepts spaces, hyphens, periods, and simple balanced parentheses around area codes. Compact E.164 strings such as "+60123456789" use assigned ITU calling codes, validated at runtime. Output is canonical "(60)123456789".

parameters.description:
Filter is the client-supplied filter group. Query and form parameters

parameters.name: p
parameters.description:
Page number (1-based). Selects page mode; mutually exclusive with after
and before.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description:
Items per page. Defaults to 20, max 100 (larger values are clamped and
echoed as page_size).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor: the page after this position. Pass a previous response's
next_cursor.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description:
Opaque cursor: the page before this position. Pass a previous response's
prev_cursor.

parameters.name: total
parameters.description:
Whether to count matching rows. Default: exact in page mode, none in
cursor mode.

Group.description:
Group represents a recursive filter expression composed of Rule values
and nested Group values combined by a Conjunction.
When Group.Negated is true the entire group predicate is logically inverted.

When Group.Edge is set, the group's rules and subgroups are evaluated
against the named edge relation rather than the current entity. In that case
Group.Quantifier selects the quantifier (some/every/none) that governs
how the inner predicate applies across the related rows, and the rules'
field names are resolved against the target entity's registry rather than
the current one.

Quantifier.description:
Quantifier specifies how a set of conditions applies across the rows of a
to-many relation (edge). It is used on a Group together with Group.Edge
to express predicates of the form "some/every/none related row matches".

Only related rows the caller may read count: rows outside the caller's
tenant scope or soft-deleted rows are treated as nonexistent by every
quantifier.

and a JSON-encoded comparison value.

TotalMode.description: TotalMode selects whether a list response counts its rows.
